additional_medicare_tax._note: §3101(b)(2)/Form 8959. Not inflation-adjusted. regular_medicare_rate: §3101(b)(1) employee Medicare rate (Form 8959 Part IV baseline), statutory.

child_tax_credit._note: §24 as amended by OBBBA. Verify phaseout mechanics against Sch 8812.

early_distribution_additional_tax._note: §72(t)(1) additional tax on early distributions from qualified retirement plans (Form 5329 Part I). STATUTORY 10%. The §72(t)(2) exceptions are fact-specific and stay the filer's determination — TaxOS takes Form 5329 line 3 (the amount subject to the tax AFTER exceptions) as the input.

schedule_a._note: Schedule A. medical_agi_floor_pct is §213(a), permanent 7.5%. The SALT figures are the OBBBA §164(b)(6) regime for 2025: cap $40,000 ($20,000 MFS), phasing DOWN by 30% of MAGI over $500,000 ($250,000 MFS) but never below $10,000 ($5,000 MFS). The cap steps up 1% a year through 2029 — these are the 2025 values and MUST be re-read for any other year. NOT yet checked against the Schedule A instructions by a signer.

foreign_tax_credit_de_minimis._note: §904(j)(2)(B) de minimis election — claim the foreign tax credit WITHOUT Form 1116 and without the §904 limitation. STATUTORY $300 / $600 joint, NOT inflation-indexed. Available only when all foreign-source income is passive category shown on a payee statement (1099-DIV/-INT, K-1); §904(j)(3)(A) forfeits any §904(c) carryback/carryforward of excess. Verify against the Form 1116 instructions before signature.

child_dependent_care_credit._note: §21 child and dependent care credit. STATUTORY figures, NOT inflation-indexed — ARPA's 2021 expansion expired, so the credit is nonrefundable again and the expense caps reverted. Verify against the Form 2441 instructions before signature.

computation_notes.obbba_schedule_1a: OBBBA above-the-line deductions on Sch 1-A (2025-2028) NOT modeled in step-1.
computation_notes.p6_1_added_sections: self_employment/schedule_c/schedule_d/depreciation/qbi/ptc sections added P6.1 from statutory sources (IRC 1401-1402/274(n)/195/280A/1211(b)/168-179 per OBBBA/199A + Rev. Proc. 2024-40; PTC: tax-year-2025 ARPA-extended regime - NO 400% cliff, cliff_pct is a 100000 sentinel, figures 0-8.5%, FPL = 2024 48-state guidelines) - PENDING dual verification (workstream B); release status stays review, never auto-production.

residential_clean_energy._note: §25D(a)/Form 5695: 30% of qualified residential clean energy property cost. TERMINATED for expenditures after 2025-12-31 by OBBBA §70506 — tax year 2025 is the final year. Statutory rate, not inflation-adjusted.

retirement_contributions._note: P93 — contribution-limit rule data for the HSA/IRA/employer-plan validation waves. 2025 figures: HSA per Rev. Proc. 2024-25; IRA/401(k)/SIMPLE/SEP/415(c) and the phase-out ranges per Notice 2024-80; the 60-63 enhanced catch-up is SECURE 2.0 §109 (§414(v)(2)(E)); the 6% excess-contribution excise is §4973 (statutory, non-indexed). The SIMPLE small-employer 110%-limit variants (§408(p)(2)(E)(i)(II)) are NOT modeled and must be flagged if a SIMPLE participant claims the higher figure.

hsa._note: §223(b): Rev. Proc. 2024-25. Catch-up is §223(b)(3), age 55+, per spouse and only into that spouse's own HSA.

deduction_phaseout._note: §219(g) MAGI ranges for ACTIVE PLAN PARTICIPANTS (Notice 2024-80). mfj/qss is the range when the CONTRIBUTOR is covered at work; mfj_spouse_covered is §219(g)(7) — contributor NOT covered, spouse is. No one covered: fully deductible at any income.

roth_phaseout._note: §408A(c)(3) MAGI ranges (Notice 2024-80). The §219 limit is COMBINED across Traditional + Roth per person.

elective_deferral._note: §402(g) employee elective deferrals — 401(k)/403(b)/most 457(b), summed ACROSS employers per person. catch_up_60_63 REPLACES catch_up_50 for a participant aged exactly 60-63 at year end.

simple._note: §408(p) SIMPLE deferrals (Notice 2024-80). Small-employer 110% variants not modeled — see section _note.

sep._note: §408(k)/§415(c): lesser of 25% of compensation or $70,000 (2025). For self-employed, compensation is net SE earnings after the ½SE-tax deduction, making the effective rate 20% — the kernel must use the reduced-rate worksheet, never a flat 25% of net profit. nondeductible_excise_rate is §4972(a): 10% on nondeductible employer contributions (statutory, non-indexed).

excess_contribution_excise._note: §4973(a): 6% excise per year on excess IRA/HSA contributions remaining in the account, capped at 6% of the account's year-end value (cap not modeled; flagged when it could bind).
